title: HtmlBlockquote
responsibility: Renders the native blockquote element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlBlockquote.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native blockquote element; native HTML content rules still apply. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (no child snippet).

outputs.name: HtmlBlockquote
outputs.description: The actual native blockquote element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.

errors.name: Caller content or event error
errors.description: Supplied event handlers and rendered child snippets may throw; the atom does not catch their errors. Void elements ignore the child snippet.
